name: Moses
summary: A Hebrew raised in Pharaoh's household who becomes the reluctant deliverer God calls at the burning bush to lead Israel out of slavery in Egypt.

name: Aaron
summary: Moses' older brother, appointed by God to speak on his behalf before Pharaoh and to perform signs in front of Israel.

name: Miriam
summary: Moses' sister, who watches over him as an infant on the Nile and offers to fetch a Hebrew nurse, bringing their own mother to nurse him.

name: Pharaoh
summary: Exodus never names Egypt's kings, and chapters 1-14 involve more than one: the king who enslaves Israel dies while Moses is in Midian, and his successor is the Pharaoh who resists Moses through the ten plagues.

name: Jochebed
summary: Moses' mother, who hides him for three months and then sets him afloat on the Nile in a basket to save his life.

name: Amram
summary: Moses' father, a Levite who marries Jochebed.

name: Pharaoh's Daughter
summary: The Egyptian princess who finds baby Moses in the Nile, has him nursed by his own mother, and raises him in Pharaoh's household.

name: Zipporah
summary: Moses' wife, one of the daughters of Jethro, the priest of Midian.

name: Jethro
summary: The priest of Midian, also called Reuel, who takes Moses in as a shepherd and gives him his daughter Zipporah in marriage.

name: Shiphrah
summary: One of two Hebrew midwives who fear God and defy Pharaoh's order to kill newborn Hebrew boys.

name: Puah
summary: One of two Hebrew midwives who fear God and defy Pharaoh's order to kill newborn Hebrew boys.

name: God
summary: The LORD, who hears Israel's groaning in Egypt, appears to Moses at the burning bush, reveals his covenant name, and delivers his people from slavery.
